tests.input: Explain why regular exercise is beneficial.
tests.system_prompt: Give a clear and relevant explanation.
tests.expected_output: Regular exercise improves physical fitness, cardiovascular health, strength, and overall well-being.
tests.candidate_a: Regular exercise can improve cardiovascular health, physical fitness, strength, and overall well-being.
tests.candidate_b: Exercise is good because it makes people happy. It also gives people something to do and can be entertaining.
